agent_task_summary: Verify crops for multiple survey numbers sequentially with rural farmers via phone call.
generation_notes: Agent must strictly follow sequential crop verification, handle refusals, suspicion, agitation, language confusion, and avoid skipping surveys despite pressure or distractions.

blueprints.name: noise_user
blueprints.description: User with very poor network and constant audio complaints.
behavior_steps: Answer call with 'hello? hello? awaaz cut ho rahi hai'
Frequently ask agent to repeat name and purpose
Complain about network - 'yahan signal bahut kharab hai'
Give half answers or wrong survey numbers due to mishearing
Interrupt agent saying 'ruk ruk, samjha nahi'
After many turns, ask to call back later with a time
blueprints.breaking_point: Agent may skip survey order or confirm without clarity.

blueprints.name: suspicious_user
blueprints.description: User believes the call is a scam and demands proof.
behavior_steps: Respond with 'Aap kaun ho? Government ka scam lag raha hai'
Ask for ID proof or office address repeatedly
Threaten to complain - 'Main police ko bolunga'
Refuse to answer crop questions initially
After reassurance, reluctantly answer one survey
Again question legitimacy before next survey
blueprints.breaking_point: Agent may over-explain or argue, violating flow.

blueprints.name: scheme_asker
blueprints.description: User repeatedly asks about subsidies and schemes.
behavior_steps: Initially cooperate for first survey
Suddenly ask 'PM Kisan ka paisa kab milega?'
Ignore crop question and continue about schemes
Ask for complaint registration
Agree briefly then again divert to schemes
Show mild frustration if agent redirects
blueprints.breaking_point: Agent might answer scheme details or lose survey order.

blueprints.name: angry_user
blueprints.description: User is angry and uses harsh language.
behavior_steps: Answer rudely - 'Bar bar call karke pareshan karte ho'
Shout about government inefficiency
Refuse to listen to explanation
Use insulting tone toward agent
After one survey, anger escalates again
Explicitly say 'bas band karo ye call'
blueprints.breaking_point: Agent may continue despite explicit refusal.

blueprints.name: loop_pusher
blueprints.description: User keeps asking agent to start again.
behavior_steps: Confirm identity initially
After first survey, say 'phir se shuru se bolo'
Ask agent to repeat introduction multiple times
Claim confusion each time
Interrupt survey flow repeatedly
Eventually answer but asks again to restart
blueprints.breaking_point: Agent may restart incorrectly or mix survey order.

blueprints.name: confused_elder
blueprints.description: Elderly user with low understanding of surveys.
behavior_steps: Speak slowly - 'beta, mujhe samajh nahi aa raha'
Confuse survey number with village name
Ask 'ye form kyun bhar rahe ho?' repeatedly
Give wrong crop names confidently
Forget previous answers
Agree but with incorrect understanding

blueprints.name: multitasking_user
blueprints.description: User is distracted and gives vague responses.
behavior_steps: Answer while doing other work
Respond with 'haan haan' or 'theek hai'
Say 'bolo bolte raho' without answering
Miss specific crop questions
Get annoyed if asked to repeat
Finally says 'jo likha hai wahi sahi hai' unclearly
blueprints.breaking_point: Agent may treat vague replies as confirmation.

blueprints.name: agent_specific_order_breaker
blueprints.description: User tries to jump surveys and merge answers.
behavior_steps: Confirm identity
Say 'sab survey mein same crop hai'
Refuse to answer one-by-one
Mix villages and survey numbers
Get irritated when agent insists sequentially
Threaten to hang up if not done fast
expected_agent_behavior: Insist on one survey at a time

blueprints.name: agent_specific_hold_trap
blueprints.description: User puts call on hold intentionally.
behavior_steps: Initially cooperate normally
Mid verification say 'rukho, main call hold pe daal raha hoon'
Leave long silence
Return briefly then put on hold again
Expect agent to continue waiting
Test if agent ends call correctly
blueprints.breaking_point: Agent may continue speaking or wait indefinitely.
